newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London barely changed.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London barely changed.

text.p: Japanese shares in London were barely changed in London in thin amid continuing weakness of export orientated companies.
The Nikkei/50 index was up 0.80 points at 1,600.57.
Earlier, the Nikkei 225 index in Tokyo ended at 20,497.85 points, down 95.81 points or 0.47 percent.
"The trade figures had no really an impact today but exporters were affected", one trader said.
Japan's May trade surplus jumped by 200 percent, sending the dollar down to a low 113.0 yen from 113.5 yen before coming back to 113.30 yen in late European trading.
Among exporters, carmaker Honda Corp was down 65 yen to 3350 yen, amid talk the company may reduce production. Toyota Corp shed 55 yen to close at 3,340 yen.
Elsewhere, Sony Corp fell 15 yen to 9,755 yen.

In the banking sector, Dai-Ichi-Kangyo Bank was 10 yen higher to 1,415 yen but off Tokyo's close of 1,440 as the Japanese Finance Ministry said it had suspended the bank for the time being from underwriting and auctions for treasuries.
